# Reporting security issues

Do not include secrets, private notes, customer data, or exploit payloads exposing that data in public issues.

For this personal fork, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting interface if the repository offers it. If it is unavailable, ask `@mithudso` through an existing private contact channel for a secure reporting route. A public request for a private contact route should contain no vulnerability details. This document does not assert that private reporting is enabled or publish an unverified security mailbox.

For an upstream issue, consult the original [Huy Tieu repository](https://github.com/huytieu/COG-second-brain) for its reporting options. Preserve upstream authorship and MIT licensing.

Include the affected commit, a sanitized reproduction using synthetic data, expected impact, and relevant helper diagnostics. Read the [threat model](../docs/SECURITY.md) for trust boundaries and limitations.

No response-time SLA, supported-version window, or security certification is established. Maintainers must choose those policies separately.
